title: ConfigLock
description: The fully resolved configuration of one run (config.lock.json): every config section after overrides, plus the selected calibration file. Written by core at the manifest step (after Causivra's card, step 10a); run_manifest.config_sha256 is the SHA-256 of its file bytes, and replay loads it instead of the repo's config/.

sections.description: Resolved config sections, one entry per config file keyed by file stem (core, the ten engine names and llm); each value is that YAML file's top-level mapping after overrides, frozen to JSON. Every paths and fetch subtree is left out and config/gateway.yaml never enters the lock; ai.mode is a run parameter, not a key here. Path-valued keys are stored unexpanded as POSIX paths relative to a named root (never absolute, never with backslashes; loader check). Free keys; canonical JSON sorts them.

additionalProperties.description: Body of one config section: a free-key mapping of JSON values.

calibration.description: Calibration file selected for this run (Causentra's family resolution), or null when the run is uncalibrated (no file found, or the causentra section was not resolved).

anyOf.title: ConfigLockCalibration
anyOf.description: Identity, file hash and content of the selected calibration file.

family_id.description: Calibration family id <benchmark family>.<ai_arm>.<alert_protocol>.<fold>: the file stem under config/calibration/ and the value of content.family; verdict.calibration.family carries the same id.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the calibration file bytes; equals run_manifest.calibration_sha256.

JsonValue.title: JsonValue
JsonValue.description: Any JSON value (null, boolean, number, string, array or object of JSON values); used for free-form config section bodies.
